simple.meaning: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan , a place in the Desert
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקַן (H885) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקַן (Bᵉʼêrôth Bᵉnêy-Yaʻăqan) means Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan , a place in the Desert First listed occurrence: Deut 10 6.

definitions.short: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan , a place in the Desert
definitions.usage: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.
definitions.full: H885. Beeroth Bene-yaaqan בְּנֵייַֿעֲקָן בְּאֵרֹת proper name, of a location Deut 10:6 (compare Num 33:31-32 , where יעקן בני ), a station of Israel in desert, probably in country of Horites, compare Di.
definitions.rootNote: from the feminine plural of 875 , and the plural contraction of 1121 , and 3292 ; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan;
